dotnet test

git status
pwsh -c \"dotnet build\"
" --allowedTools "Bash" --permission-mode acceptEdits 2>&1 | tail -10

cd "C:\Users\timsc\Source\Repos\GitHub\timschreiber\claude-plugins" && pwsh -NoProfile -Command "
\$probe = Get-Content probes/hook-alternation/settings.probe.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
\$out = [ordered]@{ hooks = \$probe.hooks }
